---
title: "02 — Double pendulum"
description: "Two modes (0.6 Hz Q20, 1.5 Hz Q30): the optimal drive splits its power across both resonances."
image: thumbnails/02.png
categories: [SISO, multi-mode]

The canonical two-mode plant: a double pendulum with modes at 0.6 Hz (Q = 20) and
1.5 Hz (Q = 30), gain 300. We run the **identical full diagnostic set** as
[example 01](01-single-resonance.qmd) — excitation design, time series, a
magnitude/phase/coherence Bode stack, residuals, parameter recovery, drive safety,
convergence, and the pass-by-pass view — now with the optimal drive splitting its power
across *two* resonances. The Fisher iteration finds the split automatically; the narrower,
higher-Q mode gets a sharper, taller peak.

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Setup — imports, house plot style, plant & prior"
import sys, pathlib
_p = pathlib.Path.cwd()
for _c in [_p, *_p.parents]:
    for _d in (_c, _c / "docs"):
        if (_d / "sysid_plots.py").exists() and str(_d) not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, str(_d))

import numpy as np
import sysid_plots as sp
from sysid_campaign import run_siso_passes, param_sigmas, param_convergence_series

from system_ident.plant import double_pendulum, SuspensionPlant
from system_ident.model import TFModel
from system_ident.fisher import parameter_covariance
from system_ident.design.pintelon import prior_robust_excitation
from system_ident.backends.twin import TwinBackend

FS, NPERSEG, N_PERIODS = 32.0, 4096, 6           # T_fft = 128 s (> 3/f_min), df ≈ 0.008 Hz
TOTAL = NPERSEG * N_PERIODS / FS
ACT_LIMIT = 1000.0

true  = double_pendulum()                                                 # 0.6/1.5 Hz
prior = TFModel.from_resonances([(0.55, 14.0), (1.6, 22.0)], gain=250.0)   # both off

f_all = np.fft.rfftfreq(NPERSEG, 1 / FS)
band  = (f_all >= 0.1) & (f_all <= 5.0)
freq  = f_all[band]
Pyy, Px_tot = np.ones_like(freq), 1.0
```

## The parameters we're chasing

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Prior vs true (both modes)"
(f0p1, Qp1), (f0p2, Qp2) = sp.modes(prior)
(f0t1, Qt1), (f0t2, Qt2) = sp.modes(true)
sp.param_table(
    ["", "f₁ [Hz]", "Q₁", "f₂ [Hz]", "Q₂", "DC gain"],
    [["prior", f"{f0p1:.3f}", f"{Qp1:.1f}", f"{f0p2:.3f}", f"{Qp2:.1f}", f"{sp.dc_gain(prior):.4g}"],
     ["true",  f"{f0t1:.3f}", f"{Qt1:.1f}", f"{f0t2:.3f}", f"{Qt2:.1f}", f"{sp.dc_gain(true):.4g}"]],
    caption="Before measuring")
```

## 1 — Design the excitation

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Prior-robust two-mode drive; variance win vs flat"
Pxx_opt  = prior_robust_excitation(freq, prior, Pyy, Px_tot, 0.5, n_iter=6)
Pxx_flat = np.full_like(freq, Px_tot / (freq[-1] - freq[0]))
cov_opt  = parameter_covariance(freq, true, Pxx_opt,  Pyy, TOTAL)
cov_flat = parameter_covariance(freq, true, Pxx_flat, Pyy, TOTAL)
ratio    = np.max(np.diag(cov_flat)) / np.max(np.diag(cov_opt))

sp.excitation_design(
    freq, np.abs(true.eval(freq)), np.sqrt(Pxx_opt), np.sqrt(Pxx_flat),
    prior_mag=np.abs(prior.eval(freq)), ratio=ratio,
    annotations=[(0.6, "f₁ = 0.6 Hz, Q=20"), (1.5, "f₂ = 1.5 Hz, Q=30")]).show()
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Why does the 1.5 Hz mode get a sharper peak?
The optimal drive's peak width scales with the mode bandwidth $\Delta f = f_0/Q$. The
1.5 Hz mode has Q = 30 ($\Delta f\approx0.05$ Hz), narrower than the 0.6 Hz mode, so the
iteration concentrates power in a tighter band where its Jacobian $\partial G/\partial\theta$
is large.
:::

## 2 — Run the campaign

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Run 3 passes of Pintelon–Schoukens refinement"
tw = TwinBackend(SuspensionPlant({"POS": true}, FS),
                 {"C1:EXC": "POS"}, {"C1:RSP": "POS"}, fs=FS, sensor_asd=1e-3, seed=0)
hist = run_siso_passes(tw, "C1:EXC", "C1:RSP", prior, fs=FS, nperseg=NPERSEG,
                       n_periods=N_PERIODS, band=band, freq=freq, Pyy=Pyy,
                       px_total=Px_tot, n_passes=3, prior_uncertainty=0.5, seed=0)
final = hist[-1]["model"]
```

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Parameter evolution: prior → each pass → true"
rows = [["prior", f"{f0p1:.3f}", f"{Qp1:.1f}", f"{f0p2:.3f}", f"{Qp2:.1f}", "—"]]
for h in hist:
    (a1, q1), (a2, q2) = sp.modes(h["model"])
    rows.append([f"pass {h['pass']}", f"{a1:.3f}", f"{q1:.1f}", f"{a2:.3f}", f"{q2:.1f}",
                 f"{h['frac']:.2e}"])
rows.append(["true", f"{f0t1:.3f}", f"{Qt1:.1f}", f"{f0t2:.3f}", f"{Qt2:.1f}", "—"])
sp.param_table(["step", "f₁ [Hz]", "Q₁", "f₂ [Hz]", "Q₂", "σ/θ (CRB)"], rows,
               caption="Parameters at each step")
```

## 3 — Is the drive gentle? The measurement time series

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Drive + mirror motion, first ~64 s of pass 1"
crest = np.max(np.abs(hist[0]["drive"])) / np.std(hist[0]["drive"])
t = np.arange(int(64 * FS)) / FS
sp.timeseries(
    t, [("drive (POS actuator)", hist[0]["drive"], sp.SKY)],
    [("mirror motion", hist[0]["response"], sp.GOLD)],
    titles=[f"<b>Drive</b> — actuator (Schroeder multisine, crest = {crest:.1f})",
            "<b>Mirror motion</b> — bounded steady oscillation"]).show()
```

## 4 — Bode: magnitude, phase, and coherence

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Magnitude / phase / coherence stack"
mask = hist[-1]["mask"]
sp.bode(freq, [
    dict(name="true plant",    H=true.eval(freq),  color=sp.SKY, width=2.6),
    dict(name="measured (±σ)", H=hist[-1]["H_acc"], color=sp.GRAY, mode="markers",
         err=hist[-1]["err_acc"], mask=mask),
    dict(name="prior",         H=prior.eval(freq), color=sp.RED, dash="dot"),
    dict(name="ML fit",        H=final.eval(freq), color=sp.GOLD, dash="dash"),
], coh=hist[-1]["coh"], coh_mask=mask).show()
```

## 5 — Fit residuals

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Normalized residual + histogram"
resid = ((hist[-1]["H_acc"] - final.eval(freq)) / hist[-1]["err_acc"]).real
sp.residuals(freq, resid, mask).show()
```

## 6 — Parameter recovery against the Cramér–Rao bound

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Parameter recovery, both modes, with CRB error bars"
(f0f1, Qf1), (f0f2, Qf2) = sp.modes(final)
sig = param_sigmas(final, hist[-1]["cov"], targets=("f0_0", "Q_0", "f0_1", "Q_1", "gain"))
sp.parameter_recovery([
    dict(label="f₁ [Hz]", prior=f0p1, fit=f0f1, true=f0t1, sigma=sig["f0_0"]),
    dict(label="Q₁",      prior=Qp1,  fit=Qf1,  true=Qt1,  sigma=sig["Q_0"]),
    dict(label="f₂ [Hz]", prior=f0p2, fit=f0f2, true=f0t2, sigma=sig["f0_1"]),
    dict(label="Q₂",      prior=Qp2,  fit=Qf2,  true=Qt2,  sigma=sig["Q_1"]),
    dict(label="DC gain", prior=sp.dc_gain(prior), fit=sp.dc_gain(final),
         true=sp.dc_gain(true), sigma=sig["gain"], log=True),
]).show()
```

## 7 — Drive-safety margins

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Drive peak & RMS vs the actuator limit, per pass"
sp.saturation([{"pass": h["pass"], "peak": h["peak"], "rms": h["rms"]} for h in hist],
              limit=ACT_LIMIT).show()
```

## 8 — Convergence — every parameter

Fractional uncertainty for **each** of the four modal parameters (plus gain), pass by
pass — both modes tracked independently, not collapsed to the worst.

```{python}
#| code-summary: "σᵢ/θᵢ vs pass, per parameter"
sp.convergence(param_convergence_series(hist,
    ["f0_0", "Q_0", "f0_1", "Q_1", "gain"], ["f₁", "Q₁", "f₂", "Q₂", "gain"]),
    target=0.05).show()
```

## 9 — Pass-by-pass: the measurement sharpening

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Measured FRF + fit, overlaid per pass"
sp.pass_overlay(freq,
    [dict(meas_mag=np.abs(h["H"]), fit_mag=np.abs(h["model"].eval(freq)),
          mask=h["mask"]) for h in hist],
    np.abs(true.eval(freq))).show()
```
